title: putin says russia has advanced donetsk region surrounded some ukrainian troops 2026 09 01
text:
MOSCOW, Sept 1 (Reuters) - President Vladimir Putin said ​on Tuesday that ‌Russian troops had captured 270 square km ​of Ukraine’s ​Donetsk region in August ⁠and a large ​group of Ukrainian ​troops were surrounded.
Reuters could not independently verify his ​statement.
Russia continues ​to advance towards the cities ‌of ⁠Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, Putin said, adding that Moscow's forces ​were ​preparing ⁠to launch massive strikes against ​energy infrastructure ​in ⁠Ukraine.
